description: Deprecated: tracking is company-wide; prefer set_tracking_domain. Sets <trackingPrefix>.<domain> as the company tracking domain when the company has none. Repeating the company's current tracking hostname is a no-op; a different one changes nothing and the response message says so (use set_tracking_domain to change it). Publish the returned website.tracking.cnameRecord; sending never waits for it.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

trackingPrefix.description: Tracking subdomain label, for example links. One DNS label of 1 to 63 letters, numbers or hyphens; inbound is reserved.

name: configure_sending_domain

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `configure_sending_domain` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

website.description: The Sending domain with tracking {policy, required, hostname, status, ready, error, cnameRecord} for the company tracking domain. Publish tracking.cnameRecord; links use it once status is verified. record returned by Sequenzy.
